article.story: HANOVER, N.H. -- — Rhyjon Blackwell's 16 points helped Marist defeat Dartmouth 75-56 on Sunday. Blackwell also contributed six rebounds for the Red Foxes (1-1). Justin Menard scored 10 points and added seven rebounds, eight assists, and five steals. Kareem Thomas led the way for the Big Green (0-1) with 20 points. Brandon Mitchell-Day added 10 points and 14 rebounds for Dartmouth. Jayden Williams had 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
